note: A solubility curve (GAME_SPEC §13, Stage 57; docs/CURRICULUM.md, experiments 4 and 45): four beakers of 10.0 g of water with 5, 6, 7 and 8 g of copper sulfate pentahydrate, more than dissolves at room temperature. Read by instruments: each heated gently and stirred until its last crystal dissolves, its thermometer read then; the salt's solubility in g per 100 g of water against that temperature is the solubility curve, and ln s against 1/T its heat of solution.
